title: Form
about: Official hardcopy on pale stock: a coloured filing bar, punch holes, registration marks, a rubber stamp on the first sheet and a sheet tally.

fields.prop_accent: The issuing body's colour, as #rrggbb or a colour name, e.g. #2f5d50
fields.prop_stamp: The words of the rubber stamp on the first sheet, e.g. IMPOUNDED; no stamp when left out
fields.prop_plate: A caption above the sheets on screen; it never prints
